records.title: GNN-FiLM: Graph Neural Networks with Feature-wise Linear Modulation
records.saved_takeaway: Relation-specific receiver-hidden-state generator produces featurewise affine incoming-message transformation; Eq7/8 differ in nonlinearity placement.
records.relationship: Same conditional modulation primitive. Candidate uses static member/relation CP scales, zero extra shift, and full native HGT attention/private recurrence. Native complete GNN-FiLM equality is not claimed.

records.title: Unifying Multi-Domain Multi-Task Learning: Tensor and Neural Network Perspectives
records.saved_takeaway: Descriptor-conditioned tensor weight generation, CP outer products and equivalent gated diagonal neural paths trained end-to-end.
records.relationship: The coefficient tensor residual c⊗q⊗u and conditional diagonal gating are established; replacing condition modes with member/relation/channel is not a new tensor operator. Whole HGT committee not equated to chapter network.

records.title: Adaptive Graph Mixture of Residual Experts: Unsupervised Learning on Diverse Graphs with Heterogeneous Specialization
records.saved_takeaway: Two structural views, sparse foundational experts, dense residual experts, node fusion and reconstruction/load/CKA objectives.
records.relationship: Recent graph residual-expert prior; scoped heterogeneity means expert architectures/structural views rather than typed canonical-relation BE factors.

records.title: HGEN: Heterogeneous Graph Ensemble Networks

read_scope.incidental: Block37 qualitative regularization/result discussion was displayed; no source result used

records.saved_takeaway: Meta-path homogeneous views, multiple independently initialized/dropout allele GNNs, node residual-attention fusion, summed view decoder predictions, correlation L1 plus CE.
records.relationship: Direct heterogeneous graph ensemble task prior; independent view learners/learned fusion/joint objective differ from shared HGT cores/own-member CE/fixed raw-logit pool.

records.title: LHGEL: Large Heterogeneous Graph Ensemble Learning using Batch View Aggregation
records.saved_takeaway: Relation groups and batch-size sampled graph views; relational transforms, two-stage residual attention and correlation penalty with classification loss.
records.relationship: Batch means sampled views, not rank-one BatchEnsemble. No member×relation CP map in inspected method scopes; native full recipe/code and stronger-performance claim unqualified.

records.title: Self-Routed Tensor Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Universal Visual Adaptation
records.saved_takeaway: Frozen vision backbone, shared Tucker core/input-output projections, low-rank representation routing to core mixtures, classification and auxiliary domain-routing loss.
records.relationship: Recent input-conditioned tensor adapter prior; additive low-rank update plus data-derived routing differs from static member/relation diagonal scaling. Complete-method equality/performance transfer not claimed.

disposition: Known conditional diagonal/CP sharing operator composition; empirical graph-specific utility hypothesis only
